neighbours.label: the middle piece of 'Omicron' and 'omelet/omelette' (the token after 'Om'/'o')
fire: Hospitals braced for a winter surge driven by the omicron strain.
Scientists sequenced a new Omicron subvariant found in sewage samples.
The diner's Denver omelet comes with toast and hash browns.
He flipped the omelette carefully so it would not tear.
Travel rules tightened again after Omicron cases rose in December.
My grandmother taught me to make a fluffy French omelette.
Booster shots were recommended once Omicron became dominant.
Order the spinach omelet if you want something light.
quiet: Hospitals braced for a winter surge driven by the flu strain.
Scientists sequenced a new Delta subvariant found in sewage samples.
The diner's Denver scramble comes with toast and hash browns.
He flipped the pancake carefully so it would not tear.
Travel rules tightened again after measles cases rose in December.
My grandmother taught me to make a fluffy French souffle.
Booster shots were recommended once winter began in earnest.
Order the spinach quiche if you want something light.

notes: Spelling unit: top-32 peaks also include 'OM', 'ik', 'ics', 'ys'; the two words probably cover only part of the pole.
